title: Team Magma's Groudon 9/95 Celebrations Classic Collection Holo Pokemon NM

descriptionText:
Team Magma's Groudon — 9/95
Celebrations: Classic Collection (2021)
Holo rare carrying the Pikachu 25th Anniversary stamp on the front — this is the 2021 Celebrations reprint, not the 2004 EX Team Magma vs Team Aqua original
Illustrated by Kazuo Yazawa
Basic, 100 HP, both Fighting and Darkness type
Poké-BODY: Power Saver. Attacks: Linear Attack, Pulverize 50+
Condition: Near Mint. Sharp corners, clean edges, no whitening, no surface scratches or print lines. Photographed front and back under natural light — what you see is the exact card you receive.
